# zentral_turbo_one_time_job (Resource)

The resource `zentral_turbo_one_time_job` schedules a Turbo job (script or mSCP check) to run once in a configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zentral_turbo_configuration" "default" {
  name = "Default"
}

resource "zentral_turbo_script" "gatekeeper" {
  name   = "Gatekeeper enabled"
  source = "/usr/sbin/spctl --status | grep -q \"assessments enabled\""
}

resource "zentral_turbo_one_time_job" "gatekeeper_audit" {
  configuration_id = zentral_turbo_configuration.default.id
  job_id           = zentral_turbo_script.gatekeeper.job_id

  # deliver only within this window (UTC, no timezone suffix)
  not_before = "2026-09-01T09:00:00"
  not_after  = "2026-09-30T09:00:00"

  # scope: a specific fleet of serial numbers
  serial_numbers = ["C02XXYYZZ001", "C02XXYYZZ002"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration_id` (String) `ID` of the Turbo configuration the job is scheduled in.
- `job_id` (String) `ID` of the job to schedule. Use the `job_id` attribute of a `zentral_turbo_script` or `zentral_turbo_mscp_check`.

### Optional

- `excluded_serial_numbers` (Set of String) The serial numbers the job is excluded from.
- `excluded_tag_ids` (Set of Number) The `ID`s of the tags the job is excluded from.
- `not_after` (String) The job is not delivered after this time, as a UTC timestamp without a timezone suffix (e.g. `2026-09-30T09:00:00`). Leave unset for no expiry.
- `not_before` (String) The job is not delivered before this time, as a UTC timestamp without a timezone suffix (e.g. `2026-09-01T09:00:00`). Leave unset to deliver immediately.
- `serial_numbers` (Set of String) The serial numbers the job is scoped to.
- `tag_ids` (Set of Number) The `ID`s of the tags the job is scoped to. Empty scopes the job to all machines in the configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `ID` of the Turbo one-time job.
